methodology.signal: Computed at completed candle close; shifted one bar to execution at next open.
methodology.entry_exit: Open to close of one completed next candle; no TP/SL. Signal only after preceding candle close. No shared portfolio or simultaneous position sizing model.
methodology.metrics: Confusion counts and trade moments pooled; Sharpe/Sortino are unannualized per trade, drawdown is worst symbol-segment, not portfolio.
methodology.qualification_note: Exploratory threshold: train, validation and holdout each require >=30 trades and positive mean net return; holdout also profit factor >1. Does not correct for multiple comparisons or establish robustness.
methodology.selection: Top 3 indicators per timeframe/direction by positive net mean on train with >=30 trades; validation with >=30 trades and positive net mean is required before holdout is shown. Holdout never used for selection.
methodology.boundary: Float input uses Decimal reconstruction for near 1% body boundary; this cannot recover precision absent from upstream floats.
